name: wedding-feast-platform
description: Wedding Feast – Wedding Catering & Food Estimation Platform

scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:pages: cd frontend && wrangler pages deploy dist/frontend/browser --project-name wedding-feast
scripts.migrate:db:local: cd backend && wrangler d1 migrations apply wedding-feast-db --local
scripts.migrate:db:remote: cd backend && wrangler d1 migrations apply wedding-feast-db --remote
scripts.seed:db: cd backend && wrangler d1 execute wedding-feast-db --local --file ./migrations/0002_seed_data.sql
scripts.d1:create: cd backend && wrangler d1 create wedding-feast-db
scripts.r2:create: cd backend && wrangler r2 bucket create wedding-feast-images

author: Wedding Feast Team
